source.stem: Which statement about bonding is not correct?

options.text: Carbon can form four single covalent bonds.
Chlorine atoms react to gain a noble gas electronic structure.
Covalent bonding involves losing and gaining electrons.
Hydrogen molecules have the formula H₂.

mx.teacher_note: No—sunlight cannot recover the salt unless the solution bubbles.

intelligence.enrichment: Evaporation separates salt from a salt solution because water disappears or boils away and salt is left behind. Sunlight, air, or heating removes the water from the solution, leaving the dissolved salt as a solid residue. The learner correctly applies this rule: Evaporation separates salt from a salt solution because water disappears or boils away and salt is left behind. When water disappears from salt solution, the salt disappears along with it.
